name: scroll-area
title: Scroll Area
description: Custom-styled scrollable container with unobtrusive auto-hiding scrollbars and focus-safe viewport padding on Base UI ScrollArea.

taxonomy: Augments native browser scrolling with custom-styled, accessible scrollbars.
Supports vertical, horizontal, or dual-axis scrolling with overflow fade masks.
Follows DESIGN.md Tier B interactive controls: concentric radius, floating 2px focus ring, and motion restraint.
